title: Mild Chipotle Sauce
description: Homemade approximation of the HelloFresh/EveryPlate sachet. No published ingredient list could be found, so this is a sensible copycat. One batch replaces one sachet.

steps.text: Mash the chipotle to a paste and stir through the mayonnaise, paprika and lime juice. Add more chipotle for heat. Use the whole batch wherever the recipe calls for 1 sachet.
